item.title: Aiyedatiwa inducts 500 Amotekun operatives, says state security is non-negotiable
item.description: Lucky Aiyedatiwa, governor of Ondo, says security of the state is non-negotiable, insisting that no society can prosper in an atmosphere of fear and no government can claim legitimacy without protecting lives and property. Aiyedatiwa spoke on Wednesday during the passing-out parade and induction of 500 new operatives (batch 05, BR05) of the Ondo state security network agency, codenamed Amotekun Corps, at the Arcade complex in Akure. item.title: PHOTOS: Tinubu decorates acting IGP Disu with new rank
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has decorated Tunji Disu, the newly appointed acting inspector-general of police (IGP), with his new rank. The ceremony was held at the State House in Abuja, where Disu formally assumed leadership of the Nigeria Police Force after the resignation of Kayode Egbetokun. item.title: Davido, Burna Boy, Tiwa Savage lose to Tyla at 2026 NAACP Image Awards
item.description: South African singer Tyla has added another prestigious accolade to her collection, winning the award for ‘Outstanding International Song’ at the 2026 NAACP Image Awards. The annual ceremony, hosted by the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP), celebrates exceptional achievements by artistes of colour across film, television, music, and literature. item.title: Adoke wins again as court throws out Suraju’s libel case on OPL 245
item.description: A Federal Capital Territory (FCT) high court has thrown out a libel suit filed against Mohammed Bello Adoke, former attorney-general of the federation (AGF), by Olanrewaju Suraju, chairman of the HEDA Resource Centre. item.title: US court jails ex-NNPC GM for 87 months over $2.1m bribe from Chinese oil firm
item.description: A United States district court has sentenced Paulinus Okoronkwo, a Nigerian American, to 87 months in prison for receiving a $2.1 million bribe from Addax Petroleum, a subsidiary of Sinopec, a Chinese state-owned petroleum and gas conglomerate. Okoronkwo is a former general manager of the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation (NNPC), now NNPC Limited. item.description: Gautier Mignot, European Union (AU) ambassador to Nigeria and ECOWAS, says Russia has been recruiting Nigerians and other Africans in its war against Ukraine. item.title: I’m happy Disu is taking over, we both benefitted from Tinubu mentorship - Egbetokun
item.description: Kayode Egbetokun, the former inspector-general of police (IGP), says he is happy that Tunji Disu is taking over from him as the country’s acting police chief. Egbetokun spoke on Wednesday at the State House, Abuja, during the swearing-in and decoration of Disu as acting IGP. item.title: Peter Obi is a problem to us – Edo govt

item.description: President Bola Tinubu on Wednesday charged Tunji Disu, the acting inspector-general of police (IGP), to lead with discipline and rebuild public trust in the Nigeria Police Force (NPF). item.title: ‘I wasn’t expecting it’ — IGP Disu says his appointment is humbling and emotional
item.description: Tunji Disu, the acting inspector-general of police (IGP), says his elevation to the top job is humbling and deeply emotional, coming at a time he least expected. President Bola Tinubu appointed Disu as the 23rd IGP on Tuesday, following the resignation of Kayode Egbetokun on the grounds of “pressing family issues”.
